author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Star Trek: The Original Series brought us so many iconic designs for props, costumes, and spaceships, but the hand prop that is perhaps the most recognizable from the show is the Type II phaser. At Propstore, we get up close with one of the last surviving phaser props from production, revealing details we've never noticed before. Plus, one of Spock's hero costumes from Star Trek's third season!

Learn more about this prop and the upcoming Propstore EMLA auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/525
See all the props and costumes in this auction in the catalog: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/525

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: You may not have realized it, but you very rarely got a complete glimpse of the USS Enterprise bridge from the original #StarTrek series. Factory Entertainment Barry Eldridge explains to #AdamSavage just why, using an incredible 1/18 scale recreation of the filming set from Star Trek The Original Series!
title: The #StarTrek Set Secret #AdamSavage (and You) Never Noticed
